dedup_rule: count = distinct films carrying ANY member keyword (union, not sum). The adapter maps every member -> its canonical at promote; a film with multiple members of one canonical counts once.
expression_note: Members are exact aliases. Some tails are better as patterns when the executable layer is built (e.g. /massacre/->massacre; /.*warfare/->warfare EXCEPT naval/gang/cartel/class; /alien.*/->alien). Decide per-canonical. Genre-name keywords are DROPPED not folded (see genre-synonyms.json). Place cities fold by rule: 'city, US-state'->state; 'city, country'->country; iconic bare cities mapped (hollywood->california, hong kong->china, nyc+boroughs->new york, las vegas->nevada). NO LANDMARK RULE: named landmarks (eiffel tower, taj mahal, the white house, louvre...) are NOT folded to their country — they are held unassigned pending one collective decision. Context beats pattern: a keyword carrying a second idea is never auto-folded (german occupation of france->nazi, pacific island->world war).

unassigned_note: Keywords deliberately not folded: loose, held for a later section, or blocked on a missing parent. They live in the drag board's Reconsider box and are re-evaluated as later sweeps open.

repairs.rule: A canonical's own keyword is always a member, UNLESS it is a TMDB genre-name duplicate (genre-synonyms.dropped). Member names are stored as the EXACT corpus string, never a short form.

reconciliations.note: The board held decisions never banked to master.json. Board labels stored in short form were repaired to the exact corpus keyword. Rollups whose member lists exist only as an aggregate count are deferred to their section sweep rather than guessed.
